entities.title: shell-tools
entities.summary: The shell-tools library crate: the JSON file operations (read, search, list, stat, outline, diff_since) that zazzle's daemon runs for `zazzle call` and `zazzle stat`, with each session's memory of what it was sent, so repeats cost an unchanged marker and changed files only their diff.
entities.purpose: Holds one library of the toolbox: the crate manifest (Cargo.toml, a member of the src/macos workspace, no binary), the README with the request and reply reference, and the modules in src/. It used to be a program of its own (a CLI and an MCP server); its operations now run inside the daemon, which lends them its walk cache, its search scan and its outlines.
boundaries: Used only by the daemon (src/macos/daemon, the `shell-tools` path dependency); it depends on no other crate of the workspace.
Has no command line, MCP server or process of its own: `zazzle call`, `zazzle stat`, zazzle_call and zazzle_stat are the daemon's (src/macos/daemon/src/cmd/call.rs, src/macos/daemon/src/mcp.rs).
How agents should use the operations is written for them in agents/skills/zazzle/SKILL.md, outside this folder.
